enterMonthlyBillsDescription: Pick a year tab. Every energy carrier has its own table — enter the reading in its own native unit (m³ for gas, Gcal for district heat, kg for coal, kWh for electricity); kWh is computed automatically. Enter a tariff and the expense is computed automatically too. Copy a column from Excel and paste it straight into the table — or download the template, fill it in, and upload it back.
noBillsDescription: Use the grid above to add a carrier's monthly bills for a year.
